welcomeSubtitle: Hyper-local weather telemetry, lightning hazard alerts, and predictive AI agronomist intelligence at your fingertips.
carouselSub1: Get minute-by-minute weather updates calibrated to your exact field coordinates — temperature, rainfall, wind, and more.
carouselSub2: Detect pest pressure, disease risk, and lightning hazard in real time so you can act before your crops are at risk.
carouselSub3: AI-powered recommendations tailored to your soil, climate, and current conditions — in your own language.
enableTelemetryDesc: FarmRisk uses your location to deliver village-level weather, lightning alerts, and soil-moisture intelligence — right on your field.
permissionDenied: Location permission was denied. Choose a location manually to continue.
permissionError: Something went wrong while requesting location access.
locationSet: Location enabled. Setting up your dashboard...
langSelectSubtitle: You'll see all advisories and analysis in your selected language. This can be changed in Settings anytime.
authLoginSubtitle: Sign in with your mobile number and password to access your farm dashboard.
authRegisterSubtitle: Register with your mobile number to get personalized crop advisories and risk alerts.
